test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_table_1(id UInt64, value String) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE test_table_2(id UInt64, value String) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_table_1 SELECT (cityHash64(number, 7) % 5000000) AS key, toString(key) FROM numbers(5000000) SETTINGS min_insert_block_size_rows = 10000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
INSERT INTO test_table_2 SELECT (cityHash64(number, 11) % 5000000) AS key, toString(key) FROM numbers(5000000) SETTINGS min_insert_block_size_rows = 10000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

SELECT throwIf(count() != 2, 'join_convert_outer_to_inner: expected 1 active part per table') FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table IN ('test_table_1', 'test_table_2') AND active
test.query: SELECT lhs.id, rhs.id, lhs.value, rhs.value FROM test_table_1 AS lhs LEFT JOIN test_table_2 AS rhs ON lhs.id = rhs.id WHERE rhs.value != '' FORMAT Null
SELECT lhs.id, rhs.id, lhs.value, rhs.value FROM test_table_1 AS lhs LEFT JOIN test_table_2 AS rhs ON lhs.id = rhs.id WHERE rhs.value != '' AND rhs.id = 5 FORMAT Null
SELECT lhs.id, rhs.id, lhs.value, rhs.value FROM test_table_1 AS lhs RIGHT JOIN test_table_2 AS rhs ON lhs.id = rhs.id WHERE lhs.value != '' FORMAT Null
SELECT lhs.id, rhs.id, lhs.value, rhs.value FROM test_table_1 AS lhs RIGHT JOIN test_table_2 AS rhs ON lhs.id = rhs.id WHERE lhs.value != '' AND lhs.id = 5 FORMAT Null
SELECT lhs.id, rhs.id, lhs.value, rhs.value FROM test_table_1 AS lhs FULL JOIN test_table_2 AS rhs ON lhs.id = rhs.id WHERE lhs.value != '' AND rhs.value != ''
